sources.title: knowledgator/gliclass-v4-edge · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: knowledgator/gliclass-v4-edge is the 0.4B-parameter edge release of GLiClass v4. The labels you pass and an optional instruction tell it what to decide at inference time. It returns a score for every label in one forward pass and generates no text.

sources.title: GLiClass v4: Multimodal, Instruction-Following Encoders for Every ...
sources.snippet: The release includes five models: gliclass-v4-edge (0.4B, text): DeBERTa-based and much better at instruction following than earlier models, the best model on the Decision Index up to 1B parameters.

sources.title: GLiClass - Documentation - Knowledgator APIs
sources.snippet: GLiClass (Generalist and Lightweight Model for Classification) is a zero-shot sequence classification model capable of categorizing text into arbitrary label sets using a bidirectional transformer encoder (BERT-like).
